scope: Broaden current source comparison across DXF ACIS carrier version fields, open-source reader routes, current OCCT licensing boundaries, and downstream 3D consumers; refine implementation and evidence lanes without promoting support.

method.kind: Primary format reference, current vendor/project documentation, project source, and maintainer issue review
method.evidenceBoundary: Public documentation/source establishes published route and license boundaries only. InventorLoader, FreeCAD main, Cadze, ft_model, and OCCT pages were not pinned to immutable runtime artifacts or executed. None proves acceptance of a specific libdxfrw artifact or ACIS/AcDs payload. ODA v5.4.1 remains authoritative for DWG byte layout; Autodesk's DXF table is used only for its listed entity group-code contract.

observed: The DXF entity table labels group 70 as the modeler-format version and says the current value is 1.
Group 1 and optional continuation group 3 carry proprietary modeler data; group 350 is a soft-owner history-object handle.
doesNotEstablish: Inner SAT/SAB save-version semantics, ACIS/ASM profile compatibility, AcDs section schema, transforms, or B-rep validity.
evidence.planUse: Keep ACADVER, group-70 modeler format, embedded ACIS BinaryFile version, ASM product stamp, AcDs schema/record IDs, and entity/history handles as separate fields. Test carrier chunking and history closure separately from inner-stream parsing.

evidence.topic: OCCT open-source core versus commercial DXF and ACIS exchange
observed: The current catalog lists STEP, IGES, BREP and common mesh/scene routes as open source, while DXF and ACIS SAT/SAB translators are commercial.

The ACIS component describes geometry/topology translation with optional healing and approximation; it says input and output version compatibility are separate and publishes an output limit through ACIS version 7.
doesNotEstablish: That stock OCCT/FreeCAD contains the translator, that a commercial route is compatible with a given ASM/SAB profile, or that healed output is exact.
evidence.planUse: Do not add commercial translators as an open-source dependency or peer. If a licensed route is later selected, record entitlement, exact build/profile, healing/approximation settings, warnings, and metrics; do not equate version labels from different dialects.

observed: A FreeCAD maintainer states the stock DXF importer cannot read proprietary ACIS blobs and closes the issue as not planned.
The DWG adapter delegates via conversion to DXF and then a selected DXF importer route.
doesNotEstablish: Every explicit 3D entity's behavior in all FreeCAD releases or the result of an exact current runtime.
evidence.planUse: Keep native consumer tests tied to the exact converter, importer, operation, build, and platform. Successful converter handoff is not ACIS geometry acceptance.

observed: The DXF wrapper uses ezdxf to inspect modelspace entities, extracts entity SAT/SAB payloads, and invokes InventorLoader's own AcisReader.
Geometry is created through FreeCAD Part or a STEP conversion path; wrapper names are synthetic and no explicit source-handle/owner/block/placement crosswalk was visible in the reviewed source.
Published limitations include blending, some helix and law-defined geometry; no export route is documented.
doesNotEstablish: Complete DXF graph/entity coverage, modelspace-versus-block behavior, source association/transform closure, exact payload support, valid solids, or current FreeCAD compatibility.
evidence.planUse: Retain as optional only. Before any run, pin all components and audit input safety/resource behavior; compare source identity, owner/block path, transform, payload hash, diagnostics, and final shape topology. Do not count as DWG/AcDs support or a kernel independent of FreeCAD/OCCT.

observed: Cadze describes a 2D viewer/editor, uses dxf-parser for DXF and a separate LibreDWG dwg2dxf process for DWG.
ft_model describes itself as a 2D DWG/DXF rendering engine; its listed SOLID entity name does not establish 3DSOLID/ACIS semantics.
doesNotEstablish: An independent DWG lineage, 3D solid consumer, ACIS reader, or B-rep semantic result.
evidence.planUse: Keep both as discovery-only 2D consumer routes; exclude them from the 3D codec/kernel quorum and per-slice validation.

nextActions: Continue fast, local implementation slices; no external peer or commercial translator is a prerequisite.
Maintain separate explicit-geometry, opaque-carrier, structural-projection, B-rep, and named-consumer evidence tiers.
Never collapse host version, outer modeler-format value, inner ACIS/ASM dialect, and AcDs association identifiers into one version selector.
At the composed checkpoint only, use optional readers on locally generated or previously admitted inputs, with exact route, association, diagnostics, and topology recorded.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
